name: Fruit "Flower" Platter with Cantaloupe, Mango, Kiwi, Strawberries & Berry Yogurt Dip

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
1 (170 g) pkg raspberries
1 (170 g) pkg blueberries
½ (454 g) pkg strawberries
5 kiwifruit
1 small cantaloupe melon
½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE BERRY YOGURT DIP: Juice lemon into a small saucepan. Add raspberries, blueberries, and sugar. Set pan over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the fruit is broken down and compote is thickened, 10-12 minutes. Add vanilla, stir to combine, and remove from heat. Transfer compote to a heat-proof medium bowl, and set aside to cool slightly, about 10 minutes. Place cooled compote in the fridge and allow to cool completely, about 1 hour.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp granulated sugar
½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: When the compote is cool, add yogurt to the bowl and stir to combine the dip. Set aside.
TO PREPARE THE FRUIT: Trim and thinly slice strawberries lengthwise. Transfer to a large plate or baking sheet pan.
Peel, trim, and slice kiwis crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate with the strawberries.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; cut lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate.
Trim and peel cantaloupe; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and cut lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate.
TO ASSEMBLE THE PLATTER: We used a 14-inch round platter in this recipe. Work with what you have, adjusting the "petal" layers as needed.
Transfer some of the dip to a small bowl and place it in the center of your platter. (Reserve any remaining dip for refilling.)

Working from the outside in, arrange fruit slices on the platter to form a flower shape. Start with the cantaloupe, then mango, kiwi, and strawberries. Insert mint sprigs on the outside of the platter as "leaves."
